Hypothetical performance has inherent limitations and may not reflect actual liquidity, slippage, fees, or emotional decision-making.

sections.title: Backtests & rankings
sections.body: Backtest Lab and leaderboard figures are generated from historical Blofin OHLCV data using our confluence engine. They are educational and illustrative. They are not proof of live profitability. Date range, starting pot, asset selection, and market conditions materially change outcomes. Always verify on your own timeframe before risking real funds.

sections.title: Software only
sections.body: Bob's Bots sells automation software and documentation. We do not custody funds, execute trades on your behalf without your API keys on your machine, or guarantee uptime, fills, or exchange availability. You connect your own exchange account and control demo vs live mode.
